profiles.source: https://huggingface.co/google/gemma-3-27b-it (generation_config.json) and the Gemma team's recommended settings
profiles.notes: Gemma team: temperature 1.0, top_k 64, top_p 0.95, min_p 0. Gemma 3 has no tool-call tokens, so tools are described in the prompt (prompted mode). Some templates fold the system role into the first user turn.
Gemma 4: not yet checked against its model card; tool_mode auto lets crit doctor model decide native vs prompted. Sampling is left to the server.
